title: project to accelerate connections in rural areas.
columns:
• Total number of customers increased by 13% to
650,573 from 574,465
• 76,108 new connections were made, reflecting a
13% growth in customer numbers in 2014
• 184,000 domestic household customers were
on prepayment metering by 31 December 2014
• The Company continues to implement the
World Bank funded Output Based Aid (OBA)
project to accelerate connections in rural areas.
